with no delivery. Once work is submitted the client must request changes or dispute
(`403 FREELANCER_PROTECTED`). The freelancer can return the money at any time before release.
Reviewers refund disputed milestones. Agents can never refund.

info.name: ProofPay API
info.description:
Pay-on-proof escrow on PayPal. Generated from apimatic/src/spec/openapi.yaml.

1. Set baseUrl (default http://localhost:8080).
2. Run "Escrows → Create escrow from scope". It saves clientKey, freelancerKey, escrowId and milestoneId.
3. Requests send {{escrowKey}} as a bearer token. Set it to {{clientKey}}, {{freelancerKey}} or {{adminKey}} to act as that party.
